questions.stem: Which of the following describes angles in a linear pair?
questions.solution: Angles in a linear pair are adjacent and supplementary because they form a straight line, which measures 180°. Complementary angles add up to 90°, which is incorrect for a linear pair. Vertical angles are opposite each other and not adjacent, so they do not form a linear pair. Adjacent and complementary angles would only add up to 90°, not 180°.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a pair of complementary angles?
questions.solution: Complementary angles are two angles whose measures add up to 90°. The pair 60° and 30° adds to 90°, so they are complementary. The other options do not sum to 90°, so they are not complementary.

hi.solution: पूरक कोण वे कोण होते हैं जिनके मापों का योग 90° होता है। 60° और 30° का योग 90° होता है, इसलिए वे पूरक हैं। अन्य विकल्प 90° के योग के बराबर नहीं हैं, इसलिए वे पूरक नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: If ∠PQR and ∠RQS form a linear pair and m∠PQR = 110°, what is the measure of ∠RQS?
questions.solution: A linear pair of angles means their sum is 180°. If ∠PQR is 110°, then ∠RQS is 180° - 110° = 70°. The option '80°' would be chosen by someone who subtracts 100° instead of 110°. The option '90°' would be chosen by someone who thinks ∠RQS is a right angle. The option '100°' would be chosen by someone who adds the angles instead of subtracting them.

questions.stem: If an angle measures 40°, what is the measure of its complement?
questions.solution: Complementary angles are two angles whose measures add up to 90°. To find the complement of 40°, subtract 40° from 90°, resulting in 50°. The other options do not add up to 90° when combined with 40°.

hi.stem: यदि कोण का माप 40° है, तो इसके पूरक का माप क्या है?

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question, with appropriate terminology and correct answer placement.

questions.stem: Two supplementary angles are in the ratio 2:3. What is the measure of the larger angle?
questions.solution: Supplementary angles add up to 180°. If the ratio is 2:3, the total parts are 5. Each part is 180° divided by 5, which is 36°. The larger angle, being 3 parts, is 3 × 36° = 108°. The other options do not result from dividing 180° into 5 equal parts or do not follow the 2:3 ratio.

hi.stem: दो पूरक कोण 2:3 के अनुपात में हैं। बड़े कोण का माप क्या है?
hi.solution: पूरक कोणों का योग 180° होता है। यदि अनुपात 2:3 है, तो कुल भाग 5 हैं। प्रत्येक भाग 180° को 5 से विभाजित करने पर 36° होता है। बड़ा कोण, जो 3 भाग है, 3 × 36° = 108° होता है। अन्य विकल्प 180° के 5 समान भागों में विभाजन या 2:3 अनुपात के अनुसार नहीं होते हैं।

mr.solution: अपूरक कोनांचा एकूण बेरीज 180° असते. जर गुणोत्तर 2:3 असेल तर एकूण भाग 5 असतात. प्रत्येक भाग 180° ला 5 ने भागल्यास 36° येतो. मोठ्या कोनाचे 3 भाग असल्यामुळे तो 3 × 36° = 108° असतो. इतर उत्तरे 180° ला 5 समान भागांमध्ये विभागल्यामुळे येत नाहीत किंवा 2:3 च्या गुणोत्तराचे अनुसरण करत नाहीत.

questions.stem: In a triangle, the measure of an exterior angle is 140°. What is the sum of the measures of the two non-adjacent interior angles?
questions.solution: The measure of an exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the measures of its remote interior angles. So, if the exterior angle is 140°, the sum of the two non-adjacent interior angles is also 140°. The other options are incorrect because 40° is the complement of 140°, 180° is the sum of all interior angles of a triangle, and 90° is not related to the given angle.
